evidence: Carries the Validation label and introduces asynchronous block read-ahead during block connection in validation.cpp and blockfetcher.cpp.
rationale: Prefetching blocks from disk significantly reduces validation thread stalls, showing measured speedups of 1.15x to 1.53x during IBD and reindexing. Multiple reviewers confirmed substantial real-world performance gains across HDD and SSD configurations without introducing race hazards in pruning or indexing.
